details:
1. Enable MSAA in graphics settings (not sure if relevant)

2. Visit https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_ee4e888c-4ae1-48b1-b50c-6a2263e31caf/info which uses the latest https://github.com/MichaelMoroz/VRChatGaussianSplatting prefab (without the workaround)

3. Try taking a picture - picture is not saved and the error is printed in logs instead

Workaround: https://github.com/MichaelMoroz/VRChatGaussianSplatting/pull/7
